Neshan Maps Platform - Leaflet SDK (@neshan-maps-platform/leaflet v1.0.8)
Source: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@neshan-maps-platform/leaflet
License: ISC (see package.json of the npm package). Docs: https://platform.neshan.org
Bundled unmodified so the map does not depend on a third-party CDN.
Map types supported by this SDK build: neshan, standard-day, standard-night, dreamy, dreamy-gold, osm-bright.
